articles.title: Apogee Enterprises to Acquire GroGlass
articles.summary: MINNEAPOLIS, September 02, 2026--Apogee Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: APOG), a leading provider of architectural building products and services, as well as high-performance coated materials used in a variety of applications, announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire SIA "GroGlass" ("Groglass") for up to €62.5 million (approximately $72.5 million at current exchange rates) on a cash-free, debt-free basis, subject to customary closing conditions. articles.title: AM Best Affirms Credit Ratings of Prism Assurance, Ltd.
articles.summary: OLDWICK, N.J., July 24, 2026--AM Best has affirmed the Financial Strength Rating of A- (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of "a-" (Excellent) of Prism Assurance, Ltd. (Prism) (Burlington, VT). The outlook of these Credit Ratings (ratings) is stable.
